statement.zh: 牛津–菲尔德博物馆联合远征在基什发掘；Mackay 1925 年公布 A 墓地专报，Moorey 1978 年基于残存记录做强二手重建与牛津藏品目录。
statement.en: The Oxford–Field Museum joint expedition excavated Kish; Mackay 1925 published the A Cemetery report, and Moorey 1978 provides a strong secondary reconstruction with an Oxford object catalogue.

editorial.notes: Fact about Kish expedition publication history.
